problem: The inequality is broken: "Below cutoff, λ c, V is larger" drops the comparison sign, so the sentence has no meaning and students may misread which side of cutoff gives multimode operation.
fix: "Below cutoff, λ < λc, V is larger than 2.405, several modes travel, and they interfere at the receiver as modal noise (Chapter 1.5)."

problem: "λc near 1.1–1.3 µm" puts the cutoff very close to the 1.31 µm window. Practical single-mode fiber keeps cutoff comfortably below 1.31 µm so the window works with margin.
fix: "Single-mode fiber is designed with λc between roughly 1.1 µm and 1.26 µm, safely below the 1.31 µm window, so that both the 1.31 µm and the 1.55 µm windows stay single-mode."

problem: MFD "typically 9–10 µm at 1.55 µm" is the value usually quoted for 1.31 µm; standard single-mode fiber has a slightly larger MFD at 1.55 µm.
fix: "It is about 9–10 µm at 1.31 µm and about 10–11 µm at 1.55 µm, slightly larger than the core."
